title: How to Install a New Toilet: Shutoffs, Flange Prep, and Wax Ring Assembly

locations.name: Residential bathroom (probable)
locations.basis: Transcript shows toilet installation in a home bathroom setting with ceramic tile floor, closet flange, and wax ring. No explicit filming location identified.

summary: This video progressively demonstrates a full toilet install in a residential bathroom: shutting off the main water, adding a service shut-off, trimming and configuring copper supply piping, preparing and securing the drain line with a closet flange, removing old installation material, and mounting a new two-piece toilet with gasket, bolts, wax ring, and a flexible water-supply line. It covers measuring flange height, shortening the drain pipe via a drill/cutter, anchoring the flange, installing the wax seal, mounting the toilet, trimming bolts, and performing a water-test flush to confirm leak-free operation.
topics: primer and cement for PVC-to-flange connection

sections.title: Shut-off, pipe prep, and initial assembly
sections.description: The hosts begin by isolating the water supply and preparing the copper supply line. They describe shutting off the main, opening upstairs fixtures to drain, cleaning the pipe with emery cloth, and installing a solderless compression shut-off with a chrome escutcheon. The emphasis is on making a tight, leak-free connection before the pipe is cut.

sections.title: Drain prep and flange height planning
concepts: closet flange height relative to floor
sections.description: With water restored, the crew turns to the drain side. They plan the closet flange height, discuss shortening the pipe five inches using a special cutter wheel, and verify the flange positioning relative to the wall to align the closet bolts at 9 and 3 o'clock.

sections.title: Flange fitting, tile prep, and floor securing
concepts: primer and cement for PVC pipe to flange
sections.description: This section covers testing the flange fit, ensuring correct orientation for toilet bolts, removing concrete or thinset obstructing the flange area, and preparing to secure the flange. The crew explains using primer and cement to bond PVC components and then anchors the flange to the tiled floor.

sections.title: Toilet assembly: gasket, tank, bolts, and wax ring
sections.description: The host introduces the standard two-piece toilet and the close-coupled kit with its gasket. They assemble the tank onto the bowl, secure the tank bolts, install the toilet seat, and position the wax ring on the flange while aligning the closet bolts for secure mounting.

sections.title: Final connections and test flush
sections.description: The final steps include securing the toilet to the flange with wax seal, trimming protruding bolts, attaching the stainless steel flexible water-supply line, turning the water back on, and performing a test flush to verify there are no leaks.

featured_techniques.technique: Compression shut-off valve installation on copper supply line
Shortening drain pipe inside floor using a cutter wheel for exact depth
Bonding PVC flange to drain pipe with primer and cement
Wax ring installation and precise toilet alignment over bolts
Trimming closet bolts with mini hacksaw for proper length
Installing stainless steel flexible water supply line
